messages.subject: Project Ironvale - bring-down call Thursday?
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Can we get a bring-down call in the diary for Thursday on Ironvale? We want to confirm the warranty position before we sign next week and run through the disclosure against the management warranties. Same team as last time.

Margaret
Crestview Capital
